method.state: S = (sgn G_plus, sgn G_minus, sgn discriminant, n_unstable)
checks: missing_critical_curve: a sign flip between consecutive probes on a scan line with no committed edge of the matching mechanism between them
forbidden_component_flip: crossing one committed edge flips a component that mechanism may not flip
no_flip_across_edge: a committed edge across which its own component does not change sign
face_state_mismatch: two probes joined by an axis-aligned path that meets no committed edge, yet with different S
forbidden_component_flip_on_path: same, for paths meeting exactly one edge

violations.detail: sgn G_minus flips between m2=0.739105 and m2=0.743993 at m1=0.889000, but the committed graph has no minus_one edge there

scope: This audit falsifies completeness where it fires; it cannot certify completeness where it does not.  A critical curve that both begins and ends between two adjacent scan lines, or that never separates two probes, is not sampled.
